items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: I might have been a young boy, because I'm pretty old, but I don't remember.

ctx.x: No, but there was a Pickwick band down in Fast and Gold there used to come over, once in a while and have picnics and so on. And I think they were named the Pickwick band.
There was one band they told me used to come over here sometime, the Sam Morgan band.

Do you remember the dance? The dance band? No, I think that was from my time. I might have been a young boy, because I'm pretty old, but I don't remember. I just wondered if you heard those fellows. I believe too that they had a X-Seltz band in New Orleans. They did then, that's right, they had one. There's one other question.
